facts.material: plastic body (assumed sheeting/film, not a textile fabric) with textile neck strap, piping and ties
facts.function: protective bib apron worn on the torso

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3926 covers articles of apparel and clothing accessories of plastics; chapter 39 note 2(p) excludes goods of Section XI, so plastic must not be a textile or coated textile
GRI 3(b): plastic body gives essential character over textile straps and ties

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies to aprons of coated or laminated textile fabric, where textile gives the character; here the body is plastic
aprons of vulcanized rubber, not plastic
textile aprons of cotton; not the material here

missing_facts: whether the apron body is solid plastic sheeting or plastic-coated textile fabric
classification.rationale: A bib apron of plastic with minor textile trimmings is an article of apparel and clothing accessory of plastics under heading 3926, with a specific statistical line for aprons. Rulings seen (G82959, G83072) concerned textile aprons and were not relied on.
